The app represents vessel states mainly with icons, not large written status labels.
A separate Screenshot-tool localhost preview check failed with Cross-origin write rejected. The fresh capture run used the configured hosted development origin and completed successfully.

The source UI has an origin extraction proposal that cannot be confirmed through the server's allowed CONFIRM_FIELD list. The final scenario does not claim that proposal was confirmed; it explicitly confirms the necessary weight correction and reviews documents and customs through supported controls.
No app changes, dependency changes, production provider actions, or original-film modifications.
